pr_comments:
> When all items are already selected, Select All cannot be selected from the command palette, but is available from the toolbar button.

Isn't this the expected behavior?

> > When all items are already selected, Select All cannot be selected from the command palette, but is available from the toolbar button.
> 
> Isn't this the expected behavior?

I don't know but in the current implementation, Select All is disabled when all items are selected.
![image](https://github.com/files-community/Files/assets/66369541/4ff123de-0aef-4d55-bb54-28db037cd2e5)
In any case, there should be consistency in the commands that can be selected from the command palette and toolbar buttons.

@hishitetsu I think there's a misunderstanding. The home page doesn't provide selectable items the same way the open folder context does. Notice the toolbar doesn't exist on the home page for this reason. Now, enter a folder. Here, items are selectable and both the command palette and the toolbar are available. Could you try again? I made a small fix and everything involving this issue should be resolved. Please let me know :)

It is correct that the selection commands are not displayed in the command palette on the home page, but all other commands were also missing. However, your last commit seems to have fixed this as well.
Now everything seems to be working as expected. Thank you.
I will now review the code in terms of code base quality and refactoring.

@hishitetsu Thank you for your thoughtful suggestions. I've refactored to meet these recommendations including removed unnecessary toggle code and missing if brackets. The double checks in the Actions code seems to be necessary because the toolbar and the command palette each need to be treated. Please let me know what you think.
@hishitetsu Refactoring done and ready for review
@yaira2 Thanks for the suggestion. I've used a simple setter in the latest commit instead of firing an event.
@hishitetsu and @yaira2 Thank you for your patience with me. I'm a first timer. Please let me know what you think about the latest commit.

issue_context.title: Bug: File selection commands don't appear in the command palette
issue_context.body:
### Description

File selection commands such as Select all, Clear selection, and Invert selection are already implemented, but they don't show up when the command palette is opened.

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Open a folder.
2. Open the command palette.
3. File selection commands don't appear.

### Requirements

File selection commands should show up when the command palette is opened.

- [ ] Select all
- [ ] Clear Selection
- [ ] Invert selection

### Files Version

2.5.24.0

### Windows Version

10.0.19045.3324

### Log File

n/a
comments: @yaira2 May I please be assigned this issue? Thanks!
You can just open a pull request with the fix, no need to ask to be assigned

review_comments: Shouldn't `IsCommandPaletteOpen` be set to `false` if `sender.Text.StartsWith(">")` is false?
Great. I added this logic to the else branch.
